The '''All Terrain Kashyyyk Transport (AT-KT)''', also known as the '''AT-ST ("Hunter")''' when used on other worlds, was an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] variant.<ref name="TFUCG" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:WookieesUnderFire-TFUCG.jpg|thumb|left|200px|An AT-KT firing on Wookiee insurgents]]
The [[Walker/Legends|walker]] was equipped with large anti-personnel [[Net gun/Legends|net guns]] on each side of the cockpit area and an array of other weaponry.<ref name="TFUCG" />

==History==
The walker was used on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], to more effectively deal with the continued [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] insurgency. They were used alongside [[All Terrain Attack Pod/Legends|AT-AP]] artillery in devastating attacks on the massive Wookiee tree cities.<ref name="TFUCG" />

[[Ozzik Sturn]], an Imperial captain based on Kashyyyk with the orders of "protecting" (a.k.a. trapping) Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to keep Bail Organa from revolting against the Empire, and an avid game hunter, made use of a self-modified AT-KT walker when he was governing the Imperial base on the Wookiee homeworld. He was killed and the walker was destroyed by [[Galen Marek]] during his [[Mission to Kashyyyk (Great Jedi Purge)|mission]] to the jungle world.
